answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing, each measured. (1) cairn_wire_instances (cairn/devices/recovery/bootstrap.sh:375) links every executable in cairn/devices/<d>/0/bin/* into the instance root, so a new class file needs no walk change. (2) 96c1's _floor_wiring_gap triggers the walk when a class verb lacks its link, so a box already walked lays it on its next bin/cairn run. (3) cli_main(CairnShim, []) prints the device line with rc 0 and no bus.
